title: Computation machine states
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $e$, define an inductive type of states with the following constructors: the parameter-free states listed as count, count increment, base increment, tail check, tail read, tail done, reset decode, decode, decode down, decode read, decode done, canonical, canonical reset, canonical read, inner prepare, length bound, length query, length increment, double test, double down, lookup reset, prefix hit, prefix bit, suffix hit, and suffix reset; states additionally parameterized by elements of the indicated finite sets and Boolean values as specified in their constructors, including copy stages in an eight-element set, counters in an $(e+2)$-element set, and the factor-increment counter in a $(2C+3)$-element set.
caveat: The constructors encode detailed machine control states, but their names alone do not specify an external computational interpretation.
